name: form-filler
description: Fill out forms (web, native macOS, or PDF) end-to-end and get smarter with every one — filling from a persistent profile of everything prior forms taught it, so a value like DOB entered once is auto-known on every form after. Operates from the conviction that the agent is already capable: it verifies its real tools before ever claiming it can't, sees via screenshots, types via System Events / cua-driver, and stops only at the lines a human must own (final submit, legal attestations, dishonest or ineligible input).
